name: structfield_reset
derived_from: 10 independent OpenSSL fixes found by historical commit search (results/historical_recurrence_search.md), e.g. dh_finish/dsa_finish (a32df28664/73f3bd8871), SRP_user_pwd_set1_ids (792b2c8da2), TLS1-PRF KDF (72029afd91)
invariant: If a function releases the object a struct-field out-parameter points to (OBJ->FIELD, for OBJ one of the function's own pointer parameters), it must reset OBJ->FIELD on every path to function exit.
violation: function exit reachable from a Released state without passing a Reset
status: exploratory, built and validated this session against 2 of the 10 historical motivating pairs; not as thoroughly unit-tested as Protocol A/B
notes: No function or struct-field names appear in the rule. Conservative: only a one-level OBJ->FIELD/OBJ.FIELD off a bare parameter identifier is tracked; no multi-level chains, no array-indexed bases, no aliasing analysis.
